notes.title: July 2025 update
notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWS_B7HHLJo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Hey everyone, it’s been a while! Big thanks to everyone who shared feedback! I’ve listened and made changes:[/p][list][*][p]Major UI overhaul for barter, inventory, and dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Less intrusive cursor that fades after the first click[/p][/*][*][p]Combat tiles now show reachable areas, not just individual squares. Green areas highlight the area where you will still have enough action points to attack after moving[/p][/*][*][p]Trailer and screenshots have been refreshed too![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, I’d love to hear your thoughts and I’m all ears for more feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560408/f32d732f838add9c1b415e0225b0ed19e55fac7f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560408/d7b3d1e5614237514d9fd4acb31f73d1c5114fbb.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560408/ca5c5ea06f30b33395ead00255ee8e1a7a3980c7.png"][/img][/p]
